name: lengrvis
description: Lengrvis workspace packaging and QA scripts

scripts.qa:gate: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/test.ps1 -- --maxfail=1 && npm --prefix desktop run smoke
scripts.release:quick: npm run qa:gate && npm run release:safety && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build_all.ps1 -VerifyOnly
scripts.release:check: npm run qa:gate && npm run release:safety && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/build_all.ps1 -VerifyOnly -RunExecutableSmoke -SmokeTimeoutSeconds 45
